First public release of **mriseq**, a LaTeX/TikZ package for MRI pulse
sequence diagrams.

**Download:** `mriseq.sty` (put it next to your document or upload it to
Overleaf), the manual `mriseq-doc.pdf`, or the complete zip.

### What's in it

* Ready-made, physically consistent diagrams: spin echo, gradient echo,
  inversion recovery, EPI (GRE/SE, single/multi-shot), turbo spin echo,
  diffusion-weighted SE and SE-EPI.
* Your own diagrams with RF pulses, trapezoid gradients, phase tables, ADC,
  signals, free waveforms, markers and intervals.
* Choose rows, time window, marked timings, numbers and time axis.
* Long pauses cut with axis cut marks; several repetitions (TRs).
* k(t) rows and a k-space trajectory panel; shading of equal gradient areas.
* Colour, black-and-white and grayscale styles; compact layout for subfigures.

Requires a LaTeX kernel from 2022-06 or newer (TeX Live 2022+, Overleaf).

*This package was developed with substantial assistance from a generative AI
tool (Claude Code, by Anthropic) under the direction of the author; please
report errors in the issue tracker.*
